module: MCP tools for the World Editor: enable/disable, state, selection, undo/redo, edit modes, open/save a level, list classes, create objects and modify their transform, with undo history. Loads editor_main on demand.
notes: Most tools require the editor to be active (set_editor_active active=true, asynchronous over a few frames; check with editor_status), otherwise they return an explicit error.

editor_load_level then forces editor.active=false: the code explains that openLevel sets editor.active=true before the mission starts, which would make the F11 activation path be ignored; setting it back to false allows the full activation to run again.

create_editor_object and set_editor_transform go through editor.history (undoable) and mark the editor "dirty"; create_editor_object selects the new object. Defaults: class TSStatic, shape no_mesh.dae, collisionType and decalType 'Collision Mesh', position 10 m in front of the camera, parent = selected parent or MissionGroup.
Rotation of set_editor_transform: euler {x,y,z} in degrees or quaternion rot {x,y,z,w} (rot takes precedence); scale a uniform number or {x,y,z}. Only the components provided change.
editor_save_level writes the level to disk; use with caution.

editor_status.desc: Editor state: active, initialized, dirty, levelName, levelPath, editMode, selectionCount, undoCount, redoCount, headless.

returns.desc: true if editor_main fails to load.

set_editor_active.desc: Enables or disables the World Editor (editor.setEditorActive).

select_editor_objects.desc: Selects objects by id, ids[] or name.

args.desc: {id?, ids?: integer[], name?: string, mode?: 'new'|'add'|'remove'|'toggle' (default new)}

returns.desc: true if nothing is selected or on error.

list_edit_modes.desc: Lists the registered edit modes and the current mode.

set_edit_mode.desc: Changes the edit mode by name (editor.selectEditMode).

fit_view_to_selection.desc: Frames the editor camera on the selection (fitViewToSelectionSmooth or fitViewToSelection).

returns.desc: true if nothing is selected or on error.

editor_load_level.desc: Opens a level in the editor (editor.openLevel, loses unsaved changes, asynchronous). Appends a trailing '/' to a folder.

returns.desc: true if there is no level path.

list_editor_classes.desc: Lists (500 max, sorted) the classes derived from SimObject via Sim.getSimObjectDerivedClassNames.

create_editor_object.desc: Creates a scene object (worldEditorCppApi.createObject), configures fields, name, position, scale, yaw, adds it to the parent and records a CreateObject history action.

args.desc: {class?|classname?: string, shape?|shapeName?: string, name?: string, pos?: {x,y,z}, scale?: number|{x,y,z}, yaw?: number°, parent?: string, parentId?: integer, fields?: table, field?: string, value?: any, index?: string, collisionType?: string, decalType?: string}

set_editor_transform.desc: Applies position/rotation/scale to objects in a single undoable history transaction.

args.desc: {items?: {id|name, pos?, euler?|rot?, scale?}[], id?, ids?, name?, pos?, euler?, rot?, rotation?, scale?}. Without a target, uses the selection.
